meta.title: Kyrion — Local-first intelligent home platform
meta.description: Kyrion is a local-first platform for intelligent home control, automation and connected devices. Currently in development.

common.notFoundDescription: Explore the platform or return to the Kyrion homepage.
common.footerNote: An independent platform in active development. Not yet generally available.

home.title: Your home.
home.description: Connect your devices, bring your home together, and stay in control. Built around your infrastructure. With intelligence on your terms.
home.heroNote: A working prototype. A considered foundation. Built step by step.
home.diagramCaption: An ecosystem vision. Core validates actions across every interface; voice is evolving and automations are planned.
home.featuresDescription: One coherent layer above the devices and services you already use. A foundation for everyday control, with room to grow.
home.ecosystemTitle:
Many systems.
One place to bring them together.
home.ecosystemDescription: Integrations connect the devices. Core holds the rules. Web, voice and optional intelligence give you different ways to interact—with the same controlled action path.
home.veloraDescription: An evolving interaction layer for your home. Local chat and bounded device-command proposals exist today. Reliable, natural voice interaction is the next step.
home.developmentEyebrow: BUILT IN THE OPEN, STEP BY STEP
home.developmentTitle:
Real progress.
A clear development boundary.
home.developmentDescription: Kyrion is a working development prototype moving toward a private alpha. Core control paths exist; wider usability, voice reliability and new capabilities still need validation.
home.developmentNote: No public release date. No general availability. Features and architecture may change.

features.title: Local-first architecture
features.description: Core control and data stay on your infrastructure wherever practical. External services are optional and visible.

features.title: Unified device control
features.description: Rooms, lights and device state in one place. Working Nanoleaf, Zigbee and bounded Bluetooth control paths.

features.title: Privacy & ownership
features.description: Core owns permissions and validates actions. Your personal data is never an unrestricted instruction source.

features.title: Extensible integrations
features.description: Stable capabilities connect different ecosystems. Home Assistant import is read-only; a public plugin system is planned.

features.title: A home you can share
features.description: Owner-issued invitations enable shared device control today. Richer household roles remain future work.

features.title: Clarity when things change
features.description: Device availability, service health and an action inspector help explain what happened—and why.

product.title:
A coherent home.
From the core outward.
product.description: Home control, connected services and optional intelligence on one foundation. Explore what the prototype implements today and what remains ahead.
product.availableNote: “Available” means implemented in the development prototype, not released for general use. Hardware coverage is bounded; individual paths may still need physical validation.
product.futureNote: These areas are experimental or planned. They are not a promise of release scope or timing.

capabilities.title: Home control
capabilities.description: Manage rooms, lighting and device state through a common catalog. Nanoleaf, Philips Hue via Zigbee and a bounded Bluetooth light path have working implementations.

capabilities.title: Connected ecosystems
capabilities.description: Native control paths plus a bounded, read-only Home Assistant device/state import. The HA import still awaits physical verification.

capabilities.title: Local intelligence
capabilities.description: Local streaming chat and bounded German/English command proposals. Core validates permissions and targets before any action is executed.

capabilities.title: Shared installations
capabilities.description: Owners can invite additional accounts to shared device control. Granular owner/member/guest household roles are not implemented yet.

capabilities.title: Diagnostics & activity
capabilities.description: Service health, explicit device availability and correlated action history. Inspect decisions and execution outcomes without guessing.

capabilities.title: Local infrastructure
capabilities.description: Core, local persistence and a bounded Raspberry Pi gateway form the current foundation. Cloud providers are optional capabilities.

capabilities.title: Velora & voice
capabilities.description: Wake-word detection, transcription and multi-turn voice paths exist. Repeatable end-to-end voice and audio acceptance remain in development.

capabilities.title: Automations
capabilities.description: Future scheduled and event-driven workflows through Core policy. A general automation builder and execution platform are not available.

capabilities.title: Broader integrations
capabilities.description: Versioned plugin contracts, richer Home Assistant capabilities and more device ecosystems. A public marketplace is not implemented.

about.title:
Your home should work
on your terms.
about.description: Kyrion is a local-first intelligent home platform, built to bring fragmented devices and services into one understandable system.
about.introTitle:
One intelligent layer.
Not another isolated ecosystem.
about.intro: A connected home can still feel disconnected. Lights, sensors and services each bring their own app, account and rules. Kyrion exists to make those systems work together without giving up control over the infrastructure underneath.
about.paragraph: The goal is a coherent orchestration layer above specialised systems. Integrations provide connectivity. Core manages authority. People choose how to interact.

principles.title: Local first, by intention
principles.description: Process and store information close to the home wherever practical. Essential functions should remain usable without AI or an always-on cloud connection.

principles.title: Ownership that means control
principles.description: Keep external providers optional and transparent. Make permissions, data destinations and consequential actions understandable.

principles.title: Useful before impressive
principles.description: Prove small, complete capabilities on real systems. Treat working code, automated tests and physical verification as different forms of evidence.

about.visionTitle: A foundation for the long term.
about.vision: Over time, Kyrion aims to connect more of the home: devices, media, energy systems and personal services. The direction is ambitious; each addition must earn its place through useful, controllable behaviour.
about.origin: The first user is its creator. The prototype is shaped by real local infrastructure and daily use, with broader validation still ahead.

development.title:
A platform in progress.
A direction with purpose.
development.description: Kyrion is a working prototype moving toward private-alpha validation. It is not a finished consumer product and is not generally available.
development.checkpointTitle:
Strengthen the foundation.
Then make interaction feel natural.
development.checkpointDescription: Recent work consolidates read-only Home Assistant import, service diagnostics and the action inspector. The next dedicated Velora phase focuses on repeatable processing, audio and confirmed device results.
legend: Implemented in the prototype. Not a general-availability release.
An isolated or bounded implementation still requiring validation.
Active work that has not met its acceptance boundary.
Future direction. Scope and delivery are not committed.

roadmap.title: Validate the everyday experience
roadmap.description: Reliable voice feedback, observable outcomes and repeatable behaviour on local hardware.

roadmap.title: Build deeper home coordination
roadmap.description: Automations, richer household permissions and further integration capabilities.

roadmap.title: Open up carefully
roadmap.description: Public documentation, broader validation and extension contracts before a public marketplace.

development.disclaimer: Features, scope and architecture may change as the platform is tested. No release dates, public alpha access or commercial availability are announced.
